shape_language: clear readable silhouette; simplified secondary forms
line_edge: clean intentional contour hierarchy; avoid noisy micro-lines
shading: restrained cel-like value grouping with selective soft transitions
texture: subtle paper/ink character; texture never competes with focal subject
palette: muted blue-gray base with controlled warm accent
lighting_principles: light must be motivated by scene sources or explicit graphic design intent
camera_principles: story-first framing; avoid arbitrary spectacle or lens distortion
material_principles: describe material response with concrete physical or intentionally stylized cues
detail_density: highest at focal area, reduced toward supporting and background regions

characters.name: Hero
identity_invariants: same face proportions and age across all views
short dark hair with one stable silhouette
small triangular brass earring on left ear
costume_rules: costume construction remains unchanged unless a scene variant explicitly overrides it
